mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_credits (user_id, points, level, credit_score, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{points}, #{level}, #{creditScore}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_credits SET user_id = #{userId}, points = #{points}, level = #{level}, credit_score = #{creditScore}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO credit_records (user_id, change_value, reason, source_type, source_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{changeValue}, #{reason}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM credit_records WHERE user_id = #{userId}
